import ast
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

pattern = (r'twenty|forty|280|CLAIMS_LIMIT|CLAIM_TEXT|per[-_ ]task.{0,45}(cap|limit)|'
           r'(max_claims(_per_task)?|target_claim_count|maxItems|maxLength).{0,75}\b(2|6|20|40|280)\b|'
           r'(raises|reject|enforce).{0,75}(claim|clause|quota)')
process = subprocess.run(['rg','--json','-n','-i',pattern,'tests','--glob','*.py'],capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8',check=False)
assert process.returncode in (0,1), process.stderr
rows=[]
parsed={}
for line in process.stdout.splitlines():
    event=json.loads(line)
    if event['type']!='match':continue
    data=event['data'];path=data['path']['text'];number=data['line_number']
    if path not in parsed:
        parsed[path]=[n for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(Path(path).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')))
                      if isinstance(n,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef))]
    owner=next((node.name for node in parsed[path] if node.lineno<=number<=node.end_lineno),'<module>')
    rows.append({'path':path.replace('\\','/'),'line':number,'function':owner,'text':data['lines']['text'].rstrip()})
record={'pattern':pattern,'scope':'Complete tests tree: all Python test/support/embedded-capture modules; no numeric-only broad match over irrelevant fixture bytes.',
        'files_scanned':len(list(Path('tests').rglob('*.py'))),'matching_files':len({r['path'] for r in rows}),'matches':rows}
Path('tmp/cc7/scan.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
summary={p:[{'line':r['line'],'function':r['function'],'text':r['text'][:180]} for r in rows if r['path']==p] for p in sorted({r['path'] for r in rows})}
Path('tmp/cc7/scan-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'scanned':record['files_scanned'],'matching_files':record['matching_files'],'matches':len(rows),'non_unit_files':{k:v for k,v in summary.items() if '/unit/' not in k and '/support/' not in k}},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
